integrity: An analytic induction proves the all-segment claim. A standard-library exact-rational interval checker supplements but does not replace the proof. Source comparisons distinguish previously known two-segment nonquasiconcavity from the unbounded-mode theorem.
scientific_limitations: Nonconstructive induction for arbitrary segment count; exact finite witnesses supplied for one to four segments.
Very unequal segment masses and widely separated valuations may be required.
Existence of multiple local maxima does not imply multiple global maxima, hard optimization instances, or prevalence in sampled markets.
Historical priority for the full all-integer claim is not independently established.
title: Arbitrarily many local price optima in a one-product common-slope logit mixture
